Israel explainer

By: Laura Byrne | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
We address the biggest news story of the week: the Hamas attack on Israel and the likely fallout.

Unique Selling Point:
The world has been taken by storm over the unexpected and (in 50 years) unprecedented attack by Hamas on Israel last weekend. We outline the events of Saturday 7 October and their aftermath, ahead of a studio discussion about the geopolitical context and implications.

ISRAEL EXPLAINER SCRIPT

UPSOUND Social media videos from earliest available moments. Hamas footage of attacks.
UPSOUND: NEWS HEADLINES: The Israelis woke up today to find their worst nightmares had come true … in a surprise attack… by air land and sea.
VOICEOVER: Last Saturday, Hamas gunmen launched a swift and brutal attack on over 20 Israeli towns and military bases.
UPSOUND DANIELLE BITON: I witnessed with my own eyes dead bodies in the entrance of the Kibbutz. Some of them were burned, some of them were missing parts…
VOICEOVER: Danielle Biton lives in an Israeli kibbutz just a few kilometres from Gaza. VISUALS COURTESY DANIELLE BITON
UPSOUND DANIELLE BITON: A lot of the people that I know were murdered or kidnapped or in an unknown location…
VOICEOVER: Rockets penetrated as far as Tel Aviv and Jerusalem. Israeli military forces were apparently caught completely off guard. Hamas commander Mohammad Deif claimed the attack was retaliation for Israeli crimes against the Palestinian people.
UPSOUND MUHAMMAD DEIF: We have decided to put an end to all that with the help of God so that the enemy will understand that the time of impunity is over.
VOICEOVER: Within hours, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu declared war on Hamas.
UPSOUND NETANYAHU: The enemy will pay an unprecedented price.
UPSOUND NEWS REPORT: Israeli forces striking back.
VOICEOVER: A ruthless Israeli retaliation has followed.
UPSOUND PLESTIA ALAQAD (INSTAGRAM): We’re here just listening to bombs. [...] We’re evacuating right now.
VOICEOVER: Plestia Alaqad is a journalist living in Gaza.
UPSOUND PLESTIA: The more I walk, the more speechless I get.
VOICEOVER: Israel has cut off electricity, food and fuel supplies to Gaza, while its troops apparently prepare for a massive ground offensive. By Friday, at least 2800 people were reported dead and nearly 10 000 injured on both sides of the border. Israeli death toll 1300; 3000 wounded.
